name: The Last Deposit: Svalbard
description: A story-driven start inside the Svalbard Global Seed Vault: the polar night is endless, a blizzard rages over the arctic wastes, and beneath the permafrost the world's last seeds wait with you.  Adds the vault structure, three overwintering-crew professions, and the scenario 'The Last Deposit'.

name: ETERNAL_TIME_OF_DAY
//: The long polar night: the sun never rises. Non-stub, so it overrides the built-in world default (same mechanism Aftershock uses for DEFAULT_REGION).
